cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Inspector, please approve our invisible landing. The museum opens Monday. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We've budgeted enough confidence to hold twenty visitors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How am I supposed to certify confidence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign under 'load-bearing.' Your professional certainty will support the inspectors too, so we won't need scaffolding for the next inspection.
